name: Piano
description: A local-first piano song library with 88-key playback and falling-note practice visualization.
author: Moldable

capabilities.name: Piano songs
capabilities.description: Read and import Piano song data in the active workspace.

scopes.name: List songs
scopes.description: List installed Piano songs with summary metadata.

scopes.name: Get song
scopes.description: Read one complete Piano song JSON document, including notes and tempo/meter maps.

scopes.name: Get song sound settings
scopes.description: Get a song's suggested/default sound, user override, and effective sound choice.

scopes.name: Set song sound settings
scopes.description: Set or clear a song's suggested/default sound and user override sound choice.

scopes.name: Import MIDI file
scopes.description: Import an existing local .mid or .midi file as a deterministic Piano song JSON document.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to an existing .mid or .midi file.

songId.description: Optional deterministic song id. Defaults to a slug of the MIDI filename.

title.description: Optional display title. Defaults to the MIDI filename.

folderId.description: Optional folder id to assign the imported song to.

folderName.description: Optional existing folder name to assign the imported song to.

createFolder.description: Create folderName if it does not already exist. Defaults to false.

replaceSongId.description: Optional previous song id to remove after importing.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing song with the same songId.

scopes.name: Create or replace song
scopes.description: Create or replace a complete Piano song JSON document and optionally place it in a folder. Use this for chat-created lessons and manual song/note edits instead of writing files directly.

song.description: Complete PianoSong object with id, title, tempo/meter fields, and notes.

folderId.description: Optional existing folder id to assign the song to.

folderName.description: Optional existing folder name to assign the song to.

createFolder.description: Create folderName if it does not already exist. Defaults to false.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing song with the same id.

allowEmpty.description: Allow creating a temporary song shell with zero notes. Useful before piano.songs.patch appends notes in chunks.

soundSettings.description: Optional suggested/override sound settings for the song.

scopes.name: Create or replace song from JSON file
scopes.description: Read a local JSON file containing either a complete PianoSong object or a { song, ...options } envelope, validate it, persist it as a Piano song, and optionally place it in a folder. Use this for large chat-generated songs to avoid sending thousands of notes through RPC payloads.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to a .json file containing a PianoSong or { song, ...options } envelope.

folderId.description: Optional existing folder id to assign the song to. Overrides the file envelope.

folderName.description: Optional existing folder name to assign the song to. Overrides the file envelope.

createFolder.description: Create folderName if it does not already exist. Overrides the file envelope.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing song with the same id. Overrides the file envelope.

allowEmpty.description: Allow creating a song shell with zero notes. Overrides the file envelope.

soundSettings.description: Optional suggested/override sound settings. Overrides the file envelope.

scopes.name: Patch song notes
scopes.description: Apply surgical note operations to an existing song: append notes, replace all notes, upsert notes by id, delete notes by id/time range, or replace a time range. Use this for piece-by-piece manual song creation/editing without resending the full song.

metadata.description: Optional partial song metadata to merge before saving.

noteOperations.description: Operations such as { type: 'append', notes }, { type: 'replaceAll', notes }, { type: 'upsert', notes }, { type: 'delete', ids/start/end }, or { type: 'replaceRange', start, end, notes }.

sortNotes.description: Sort notes by start/midi/id after applying operations. Defaults to true.

allowEmpty.description: Allow the patched song to temporarily have zero notes.

folderId.description: Optional existing folder id to assign the song to.

folderName.description: Optional existing folder name to assign the song to.

createFolder.description: Create folderName if it does not already exist. Defaults to false.

soundSettings.description: Optional suggested/override sound settings for the song.

scopes.name: Patch song from JSON file
scopes.description: Read a local JSON file containing a piano.songs.patch request or an array of note operations, apply it, and persist once. Use this for large surgical edits so chat can write/pipeline a patch file instead of embedding huge note arrays in the RPC call.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to a .json file containing { songId, metadata, noteOperations, ...options } or an array of note operations.

songId.description: Target song id. Required when the file contains only an operations array. Overrides songId in the file envelope.

sortNotes.description: Sort notes by start/midi/id after applying operations. Overrides the file envelope.

allowEmpty.description: Allow the patched song to temporarily have zero notes. Overrides the file envelope.

folderId.description: Optional existing folder id to assign the song to. Overrides the file envelope.

folderName.description: Optional existing folder name to assign the song to. Overrides the file envelope.

createFolder.description: Create folderName if it does not already exist. Overrides the file envelope.

soundSettings.description: Optional suggested/override sound settings. Overrides the file envelope.

scopes.name: Read library revision
scopes.description: Read a lightweight revision token for song, folder, and song sound data so clients can refresh after external changes.

capabilities.name: Piano folders
capabilities.description: Read Piano library folders in the active workspace.

scopes.name: List folders
scopes.description: List Piano song folders and their song IDs.

capabilities.name: Piano iPhone app
capabilities.description: Read bounded Piano library and learning-guide projections for NativeUI.

scopes.name: Read Piano mobile view
scopes.description: Read songs, folders, courses, and lesson reference material without exposing playback or MIDI controls.

scopes.name: Update Piano lesson completion
scopes.description: Set completion for one course lesson and return a bounded receipt.

scopes.name: Search Piano mobile library
scopes.description: Search the saved song library by title, artist, composer, or source.

scopes.name: Organize Piano mobile library
scopes.description: Create or rename a folder, or move one saved song.

scopes.name: Delete Piano mobile library item
scopes.description: Delete one song or folder after host confirmation.

scopes.name: Reset Piano course progress
scopes.description: Reset all lesson progress in one course after host confirmation.

capabilities.name: Piano UI drive
capabilities.description: Drive durable Piano outcomes in the active workspace, including resolving and playing a piece before the app window is warm.

scopes.name: Describe UI views
scopes.description: List every navigable Piano view (library, courses, folder, course, lesson, practice) with what entityId and params mean for each. Call this before piano.ui.navigate to learn valid view ids.

scopes.name: Navigate the UI
scopes.description: Navigate the Piano UI to a view. Writes a per-workspace navigation intent that the open app applies immediately (last request wins). Use piano.ui.describe for the valid view ids and their entityId/params meanings.

entityId.description: Entity to open: folder id for the folder view, course id for the course view, lesson id for the lesson view, song id for the practice view. Not used for library or courses.

params.description: Optional view-specific params, e.g. { "part": "bass" } or { "mode": "practice" } for the practice view, { "courseId": "..." } for the lesson view.

scopes.name: Open piece
scopes.description: Open a piece's falling-notes practice view without starting playback. pieceId is a song id from piano.songs.list. Use piano.ui.playPiece when the user asks to hear or play a piece.

scopes.name: Start practice mode
scopes.description: Open a piece in the practice view restarted from the beginning, stopped and ready to practice, optionally isolating one hand. Note: Piano has no server-side playback engine (audio plays in the client), so this navigation is how chat puts a piece on screen for practice.

part.description: Optional hand isolation: 'bass' shows notes below the split note, 'melody' shows the split note and above. Defaults to 'all'.

scopes.name: Play piece
scopes.description: Resolve a human piece title or song id and queue one durable outcome that restores its library folder, opens its falling-notes practice view, prepares audio, and requests playback exactly once when the Piano client is warm. Playback ownership transfers safely if Moldable replaces the warming renderer with a dedicated app window. Use this directly for requests such as "play Fur Elise" instead of issuing separate folder, song, navigation, and play commands. The initial result is queued; browser autoplay policy may later make the status interaction-required.

piece.description: A song id or exact human title, for example "fur-elise" or "Fur Elise".

part.description: Optional hand isolation. Defaults to all.

scopes.name: Read playback status
scopes.description: Read the durable status of a piano.ui.playPiece intent. Status is queued while waiting for a client or transferring between renderers, preparing while the one leased client loads audio, playing after playback starts, completed after playback stops normally, interaction-required when the browser needs the user to press Play once, or failed.

scopes.name: Read view as speech
scopes.description: Return clean speakable plain text describing a Piano view, for a voice model to narrate. No markdown or HTML. With no params it summarizes the whole library, folders, and course progress. With view 'practice' and a song entityId it reads that piece's metadata and practice state (tempo, duration, playback speed, hand split, sound, course progress).

view.description: Optional view to read. Defaults to a whole-library summary.

entityId.description: Required for folder, course, lesson, and practice views: the folder, course, lesson, or song id to read.

capabilities.name: Chat cards
capabilities.description: Song and lesson preview with optional short playback.

scopes.name: Present a saved song or lesson by song id.
scopes.description: Present a saved song or lesson by song id.

scopes.name: Read the selected song and a bounded 30-second lesson preview.
scopes.description: Read the selected song and a bounded 30-second lesson preview.

tagline: Practice piano with falling notes and a full 88-key library
